#!/bin/bash

# Health check script for ports 3000 and 8080
# Reports status to the monitoring dashboard at http://localhost:3003/api/health-report

PORTS=(3000 8080)
HOST="127.0.0.1"
REPORT_URL="http://localhost:3003/api/health-report"
FAILED=0

echo "========================================="
echo "Starting Health Check at $(date)"
echo "========================================="

# Initialize JSON payload for services
SERVICES_JSON="[]"

for PORT in "${PORTS[@]}"; do
    echo -n "Checking port $PORT... "
    
    # Try to connect via TCP using bash's built-in /dev/tcp
    if (echo > /dev/tcp/$HOST/$PORT) >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        HTTP_STATUS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --connect-timeout 2 http://$HOST:$PORT/ 2>/dev/null || true)
        if [ -n "$HTTP_STATUS" ] && [ "$HTTP_STATUS" -ne 000 ]; then
            echo "RUNNING (TCP Open, HTTP Status: $HTTP_STATUS)"
            STATUS_STR="RUNNING"
        else
            echo "RUNNING (TCP Open)"
            STATUS_STR="RUNNING"
            HTTP_STATUS="null"
        fi
    else
        echo "DOWN (Connection refused)"
        STATUS_STR="DOWN"
        HTTP_STATUS="null"
        FAILED=1
    fi

    # Append service status to JSON array
    SERVICE_ENTRY=$(printf '{"port": %d, "status": "%s", "http_status": %s}' "$PORT" "$STATUS_STR" "$HTTP_STATUS")
    SERVICES_JSON=$(echo "$SERVICES_JSON" | jq ". + [$SERVICE_ENTRY]" 2>/dev/null || echo "$SERVICES_JSON" | python3 -c "import sys, json; data=json.loads(sys.stdin.read()); data.append($SERVICE_ENTRY); print(json.dumps(data))" 2>/dev/null || echo "[]")
done

# Determine overall status
OVERALL_STATUS="healthy"
if [ $FAILED -ne 0 ]; then
    OVERALL_STATUS="unhealthy"
fi

# Construct the final JSON payload (excluding sensitive credentials for security)
PAYLOAD=$(printf '{"status": "%s", "timestamp": "%s", "services": %s}' "$OVERALL_STATUS" "$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")" "$SERVICES_JSON")

echo "========================================="
echo "Sending health report to $REPORT_URL..."

# Send the POST request
RESPONSE=$(curl -s -w "\nHTTP_CODE:%{http_code}" -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "$PAYLOAD" "$REPORT_URL" 2>/dev/null || true)
HTTP_CODE=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | tail -n1 | cut -d':' -f2)
RESPONSE_BODY=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | sed '$d')

echo "Response Code: $HTTP_CODE"
echo "Response Body: $RESPONSE_BODY"
echo "========================================="

if [ $FAILED -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "All services are running successfully."
    exit 0
else
    echo "Warning: One or more services are down!"
    exit 1
fi

    echo "RUNNING"

    echo "DOWN"
    return 1
  fi
}

STATUS_3000=$?

STATUS_8080=$?

    "app_service_3000": {
      "status": "$STATUS_3000_STR"
    },
    "web_api_service_8080": {
      "status": "$STATUS_8080_STR"
    }
  },
  "credentials_configured": $CREDENTIALS_CONFIGURED
}
EOF
)

echo "========================================="

RESPONSE=$(curl -s -w "\nHTTP_STATUS:%{http_code}" -X POST \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "$PAYLOAD" \

BODY=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | head -n -1)

if [ "$HTTP_CODE" -eq 200 ] || [ "$HTTP_CODE" -eq 201 ]; then
  echo "Report sent successfully! Response: $BODY"
else
  echo "Failed to send report. HTTP Status: $HTTP_CODE"
fi

echo "========================================="
if [ $STATUS_3000 -eq 0 ] && [ $STATUS_8080 -eq 0 ]; then
  exit 0
else
  exit 1
fi

#!/bin/bash

# Health check script to verify if services on ports 3000 and 8080 are running and responding.
# It also checks if the required environment variables are configured (without exposing their values).

# Colors for output
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
RED='\033[0;31m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

check_service() {
    local port=$1
    local name=$2
    
    # Use curl to check if the port responds.
    if curl -s --connect-timeout 3 -o /dev/null "http://localhost:$port"; then
        return 0
    else
        return 1
    fi
}

echo "========================================="
echo "Starting Service Health Check"
echo "========================================="

STATUS_3000=0
STATUS_8080=0

check_service 3000 "App Service" && echo -e "App Service (3000): ${GREEN}RUNNING${NC}" || { echo -e "App Service (3000): ${RED}DOWN${NC}"; STATUS_3000=1; }
check_service 8080 "Other Service" && echo -e "Other Service (8080): ${GREEN}RUNNING${NC}" || { echo -e "Other Service (8080): ${RED}DOWN${NC}"; STATUS_8080=1; }

# Load environment variables from .env.test to check if they are configured.
# SECURITY WARNING: We only check if the keys are present/configured. We DO NOT transmit 
# the actual secret values to prevent credential exposure and security vulnerabilities.
ENV_FILE=".env.test"
DATABASE_URL_PRESENT=false
AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID_PRESENT=false
AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY_PRESENT=false
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY_PRESENT=false
STRIPE_SECRET_KEY_PRESENT=false
LOGFIRE_TOKEN_PRESENT=false

if [ -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then
    # Read keys without exporting them or exposing them
    while IFS='=' read -r key value; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines
        [[ "$key" =~ ^#.*$ ]] && continue
        [[ -z "$key" ]] && continue
        
        # Trim whitespace
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)
        
        if [ -n "$value" ]; then
            case "$key" in
                DATABASE_URL) DATABASE_URL_PRESENT=true ;;
                AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID) AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID_PRESENT=true ;;
                AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY) AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY_PRESENT=true ;;
                ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) ANTHROPIC_API_KEY_PRESENT=true ;;
                STRIPE_SECRET_KEY) STRIPE_SECRET_KEY_PRESENT=true ;;
                LOGFIRE_TOKEN) LOGFIRE_TOKEN_PRESENT=true ;;
            esac
        fi
    done < "$ENV_FILE"
fi

# Determine overall status
OVERALL_STATUS="ok"
if [ $STATUS_3000 -ne 0 ] || [ $STATUS_8080 -ne 0 ]; then
    OVERALL_STATUS="error"
fi

# Construct a secure JSON payload containing only status and configuration presence flags
PAYLOAD=$(cat <<EOF
{
  "status": "$OVERALL_STATUS",
  "timestamp": "$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")",
  "services": {
    "app_service_port_3000": $([ $STATUS_3000 -eq 0 ] && echo "true" || echo "false"),
    "other_service_port_8080": $([ $STATUS_8080 -eq 0 ] && echo "true" || echo "false")
  },
  "credentials_configured": {
    "database_url": $DATABASE_URL_PRESENT,
    "aws_access_key_id": $AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID_PRESENT,
    "aws_secret_access_key": $AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY_PRESENT,
    "anthropic_api_key": $ANTHROPIC_API_KEY_PRESENT,
    "stripe_secret_key": $STRIPE_SECRET_KEY_PRESENT,
    "logfire_token": $LOGFIRE_TOKEN_PRESENT
  }
}
EOF
)

echo "========================================="
echo "Sending secure health report to monitoring dashboard..."
echo "========================================="

# Send the secure payload to the monitoring endpoint
RESPONSE=$(curl -s -w "\nHTTP_STATUS:%{http_code}" -X POST \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d "$PAYLOAD" \
    "http://localhost:3003/api/health-report")

HTTP_CODE=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | grep "HTTP_STATUS" | cut -d':' -f2)
RESPONSE_BODY=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | grep -v "HTTP_STATUS")

if [ "$HTTP_CODE" -eq 200 ] || [ "$HTTP_CODE" -eq 201 ]; then
    echo -e "${GREEN}Health report sent successfully (HTTP $HTTP_CODE).${NC}"
else
    echo -e "${RED}Failed to send health report (HTTP $HTTP_CODE).${NC}"
    echo "Response: $RESPONSE_BODY"
fi

echo "========================================="
if [ "$OVERALL_STATUS" = "ok" ]; then
    exit 0
else
    exit 1
fi

# Health check script for services on ports 3000 and 8080

    local port=$1

        return 0
    else
        return 1
    fi
}

check_credentials() {
    local env_file=$1
    local json_parts=()

    if [ -f "$env_file" ]; then
        # Read keys from the env file, ignoring comments and empty lines
        while IFS='=' read -r key value; do
            # Clean key and value
            key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
            # Skip comments and empty lines
            [[ "$key" =~ ^#.* ]] && continue
            [[ -z "$key" ]] && continue

            if [ -n "$value" ]; then
                json_parts+=("\"$key\": \"configured\"")
            else
                json_parts+=("\"$key\": \"missing\"")
            fi
        done < "$env_file"
    fi

    # Join array elements with commas
    (IFS=','; echo "${json_parts[*]}")
}

echo "========================================="
echo "Starting Health Check..."
echo "Timestamp: $(date)"
echo "========================================="

port_3000_status="RUNNING"
port_8080_status="RUNNING"

    echo "Port 8080: RUNNING"

    echo "Port 8080: DOWN"
    port_8080_status="DOWN"
    all_healthy=false
fi

  "timestamp": "$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")",
  "services": {
    "port_3000": "$port_3000_status",
    "port_8080": "$port_8080_status"
  },
  "credential_status": {
    $cred_status
  }
}
EOF
)

response=$(curl -s -w "\nHTTP_STATUS:%{http_code}" -X POST \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d "$json_payload" \
    http://localhost:3003/api/health-report)

http_code=$(echo "$response" | grep "HTTP_STATUS" | cut -d':' -f2)
response_body=$(echo "$response" | grep -v "HTTP_STATUS")

echo "Dashboard Response Code: $http_code"
echo "Dashboard Response Body: $response_body"

echo "========================================="
if [ "$all_healthy" = true ] && [ "$http_code" -eq 200 ]; then
    echo "Status: ALL SERVICES ARE HEALTHY"
    exit 0

    echo "Status: WARNING - HEALTH CHECK FAILED OR DASHBOARD UNREACHABLE"

# and report configuration status to the monitoring dashboard.

# Define ports to check
PORTS=(3000 8080)
HOST="127.0.0.1"
TIMEOUT=2
REPORT_URL="http://localhost:3003/api/health-report"

echo "========================================="
echo "Starting Health Check..."
echo "Timestamp: $(date)"
echo "========================================="

# 1. Check Ports
PORT_3000_STATUS=false
PORT_8080_STATUS=false

if (timeout "$TIMEOUT" bash -c "cat < /dev/null > /dev/tcp/$HOST/3000") 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "Port 3000: RUNNING"
  PORT_3000_STATUS=true
else
  echo "Port 3000: DOWN"
fi

if (timeout "$TIMEOUT" bash -c "cat < /dev/null > /dev/tcp/$HOST/8080") 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "Port 8080: RUNNING"
  PORT_8080_STATUS=true
else
  echo "Port 8080: DOWN"
fi

# Determine overall status
if [ "$PORT_3000_STATUS" = true ] && [ "$PORT_8080_STATUS" = true ]; then
  STATUS="OK"
else
  STATUS="CRITICAL"
fi

# 2. Check Credentials Configuration (Presence Check)
# Note: For security reasons, we only verify and report whether the credentials
# are configured (present and non-empty). We do NOT transmit raw secrets/keys
# over the network to prevent credential exposure.
HAS_DATABASE_URL=false
HAS_AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=false
HAS_AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=false
HAS_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=false
HAS_STRIPE_SECRET_KEY=false
HAS_LOGFIRE_TOKEN=false

if [ -f .env.test ]; then
  while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
    # Skip comments and empty lines
    [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
    [[ -z "$line" ]] && continue
    # Extract key and value
    if [[ "$line" =~ ^([^=]+)=(.*)$ ]]; then
      key="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
      value="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
      # Trim whitespace
      key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
      value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)
      if [ -n "$value" ]; then
        case "$key" in
          DATABASE_URL) HAS_DATABASE_URL=true ;;
          AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID) HAS_AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=true ;;
          AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY) HAS_AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=true ;;
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) HAS_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=true ;;
          STRIPE_SECRET_KEY) HAS_STRIPE_SECRET_KEY=true ;;
          LOGFIRE_TOKEN) HAS_LOGFIRE_TOKEN=true ;;
        esac
      fi
    fi
  done < .env.test
fi

# 3. Construct JSON Payload
PAYLOAD=$(cat <<EOF
{
  "status": "$STATUS",
  "ports": {
    "3000": $PORT_3000_STATUS,
    "8080": $PORT_8080_STATUS
  },
  "credentials_configured": {
    "DATABASE_URL": $HAS_DATABASE_URL,
    "AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID": $HAS_AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID,
    "AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY": $HAS_AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY,
    "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY": $HAS_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY,
    "STRIPE_SECRET_KEY": $HAS_STRIPE_SECRET_KEY,
    "LOGFIRE_TOKEN": $HAS_LOGFIRE_TOKEN
  }
}
EOF
)

# 4. Send Report to Monitoring Dashboard
echo "========================================="
echo "Sending health report to dashboard..."
RESPONSE=$(curl -s -w "\nHTTP_STATUS:%{http_code}" -X POST \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "$PAYLOAD" \
  "$REPORT_URL")

HTTP_CODE=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | tr -d '\r' | tail -n 1 | cut -d':' -f2)
BODY=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | head -n -1)

if [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "200" ]; then
  echo "Dashboard Report: SUCCESS (HTTP 200)"
  echo "Response: $BODY"
else
  echo "Dashboard Report: FAILED (HTTP $HTTP_CODE)"
  echo "Response: $BODY"
fi

echo "========================================="
if [ "$STATUS" = "OK" ]; then
  echo "Status: ALL SERVICES ARE RUNNING"
  exit 0
else
  echo "Status: ONE OR MORE SERVICES ARE DOWN"
  exit 1
fi

# Colors for output
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
RED='\033[0;31m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local name=$2
    
    # Check if port is open and accepting connections
    if bash -c "cat < /dev/null > /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/$port" 2>/dev/null; then
        # If it's port 3000, we can also try to curl the health endpoint
        if [ "$port" -eq 3000 ]; then
            local http_status=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:3000/health)
            if [ "$http_status" -eq 200 ]; then
                echo -e "${GREEN}[OK]${NC} $name (Port $port) is running. HTTP Status: 200 OK"
                return 0
            else
                echo -e "${RED}[WARN]${NC} $name (Port $port) is listening, but HTTP Status is $http_status"
                return 1
            fi
        else
            # For port 8080, check if it responds to HTTP or just TCP
            if curl -s -o /dev/null --connect-timeout 2 http://localhost:8080; then
                echo -e "${GREEN}[OK]${NC} $name (Port $port) is running and responding to HTTP."
            else
                echo -e "${GREEN}[OK]${NC} $name (Port $port) is listening (TCP connection successful)."
            fi
            return 0
        fi
    else
        echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $name (Port $port) is NOT responding."
        return 1
    fi
}

echo "========================================="
echo "         Running Health Check            "
echo "========================================="

check_port 3000 "Express App"
STATUS_3000=$?

check_port 8080 "Service 8080"
STATUS_8080=$?

echo "========================================="
if [ $STATUS_3000 -eq 0 ] && [ $STATUS_8080 -eq 0 ]; then
    echo -e "${GREEN}All services are healthy!${NC}"
    exit 0
else
    echo -e "${RED}Some services are down or unhealthy!${NC}"
    exit 1
fi

check_service() {
    local port=$1
    local name=$2
    
    # Try to connect using bash /dev/tcp first (fast check)
    if ! (timeout 2 bash -c "cat < /dev/null > /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/$port") 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "[ERROR] Service $name (Port $port) is NOT responding (Connection refused/timeout)."
        return 1

    # Try to get an HTTP response code using curl
    local http_code
    http_code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:$port/)
    
    if [ -n "$http_code" ] && [ "$http_code" -ne 000 ]; then
        echo "[OK] Service $name (Port $port) is running and responding (HTTP Status: $http_code)."
        return 0
    else
        # If curl failed but port was open, it might not be an HTTP service or curl failed
        echo "[WARNING] Service $name (Port $port) is open, but did not return a valid HTTP response."
        return 0
    fi
}

# Check port 3000
check_service 3000 "App Service"
status_3000=$?

check_service 8080 "Web Service"
status_8080=$?

echo "----------------------------------------"
if [ $status_3000 -eq 0 ] && [ $status_8080 -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Health check PASSED: All services are running."
    exit 0
else
    echo "Health check FAILED: One or more services are down."
    exit 1
fi

#!/bin/bash

# Health check script for services on ports 3000 and 8080
# Securely reports status to the monitoring dashboard

# Colors for output
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
RED='\033[0;31m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

echo "========================================="
echo "Starting Health Check"
echo "Timestamp: $(date)"
echo "========================================="

STATUS_3000="DOWN"
STATUS_8080="DOWN"
EXIT_CODE=0

# Check Port 3000
echo -n "Checking Port 3000... "
if timeout 2 bash -c 'cat < /dev/null > /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/3000' 2>/dev/null; then
    HTTP_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --connect-timeout 2 http://localhost:3000/)
    if [ -n "$HTTP_CODE" ]; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}UP${NC} (HTTP Status: $HTTP_CODE)"
        STATUS_3000="UP"
    else
        echo -e "${GREEN}UP${NC} (TCP open, no HTTP response)"
        STATUS_3000="UP"
    fi
else
    echo -e "${RED}DOWN${NC}"
    EXIT_CODE=1
fi

# Check Port 8080
echo -n "Checking Port 8080... "
if timeout 2 bash -c 'cat < /dev/null > /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/8080' 2>/dev/null; then
    HTTP_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --connect-timeout 2 http://localhost:8080/)
    if [ -n "$HTTP_CODE" ]; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}UP${NC} (HTTP Status: $HTTP_CODE)"
        STATUS_8080="UP"
    else
        echo -e "${GREEN}UP${NC} (TCP open, no HTTP response)"
        STATUS_8080="UP"
    fi
else
    echo -e "${RED}DOWN${NC}"
    EXIT_CODE=1
fi

# Verify credentials presence locally without exposing or transmitting their values
echo -n "Verifying API credentials configuration... "
CREDENTIALS_PRESENT="true"
REQUIRED_VARS=(
    "DATABASE_URL"
    "AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID"
    "AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"
    "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"
    "STRIPE_SECRET_KEY"
    "LOGFIRE_TOKEN"
)

if [ -f .env.test ]; then
    for var in "${REQUIRED_VARS[@]}"; do
        # Extract value safely
        val=$(grep -E "^${var}=" .env.test | cut -d'=' -f2-)
        if [ -z "$val" ]; then
            CREDENTIALS_PRESENT="false"
            break
        fi
    done
else
    CREDENTIALS_PRESENT="false"
fi

if [ "$CREDENTIALS_PRESENT" = "true" ]; then
    echo -e "${GREEN}CONFIGURED${NC} (All required keys present)"
else
    echo -e "${RED}INCOMPLETE${NC} (Missing one or more required keys)"
fi

# Construct secure JSON payload (never include raw secrets/credentials)
PAYLOAD=$(cat <<EOF
{
  "timestamp": "$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")",
  "services": {
    "port_3000": {
      "status": "${STATUS_3000}"
    },
    "port_8080": {
      "status": "${STATUS_8080}"
    }
  },
  "credentials_configured": ${CREDENTIALS_PRESENT}
}
EOF
)

# Send report to monitoring dashboard
echo "Sending health report to monitoring dashboard..."
REPORT_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -w "\nHTTP_STATUS:%{http_code}" -X POST \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d "$PAYLOAD" \
    http://localhost:3003/api/health-report)

REPORT_STATUS=$(echo "$REPORT_RESPONSE" | tail -n1 | cut -d':' -f2)
REPORT_BODY=$(echo "$REPORT_RESPONSE" | sed '$d')

if [ "$REPORT_STATUS" = "200" ]; then
    echo -e "Dashboard Report: ${GREEN}SUCCESS${NC} (Response: $REPORT_BODY)"
else
    echo -e "Dashboard Report: ${RED}FAILED${NC} (HTTP Status: $REPORT_STATUS)"
fi

echo "========================================="
echo "Summary:"
echo -e "Port 3000: ${STATUS_3000}"
echo -e "Port 8080: ${STATUS_8080}"
echo -e "Credentials Configured: ${CREDENTIALS_PRESENT}"
echo "========================================="

exit $EXIT_CODE

check_service() {
  local port=$1
  local name=$2

  if curl -s --connect-timeout 3 "http://localhost:${port}" -o /dev/null; then
    echo "RUNNING"
    return 0
  else
    echo "DOWN"
    return 1
  fi
}

echo "========================================="
echo "Starting Service Health Check"
echo "Timestamp: $(date)"
echo "========================================="

echo -n "Checking App Service on port 3000... "
status_3000_str=$(check_service 3000 "App Service")
if [ "$status_3000_str" = "RUNNING" ]; then
  echo -e "${GREEN}RUNNING${NC}"
  status_3000=0
else
  echo -e "${RED}DOWN${NC}"
  status_3000=1
fi

echo -n "Checking Proxy/Gateway Service on port 8080... "
status_8080_str=$(check_service 8080 "Proxy/Gateway Service")
if [ "$status_8080_str" = "RUNNING" ]; then
  echo -e "${GREEN}RUNNING${NC}"
  status_8080=0
else
  echo -e "${RED}DOWN${NC}"
  status_8080=1
fi

# Load and verify credentials from .env.test securely.
# SECURITY NOTE: Sending raw API credentials, database connection strings, and secret keys 
# in a health check payload is a severe security risk. To prevent credential exposure, 
# we verify the presence and format of the keys and send masked/validation status 
# to the monitoring dashboard instead of the raw secrets.
echo "Checking API credentials configuration..."

db_url_status="MISSING"
aws_key_status="MISSING"
aws_secret_status="MISSING"
anthropic_status="MISSING"
stripe_status="MISSING"
logfire_status="MISSING"

if [ -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then
  while IFS='=' read -r key value || [ -n "$key" ]; do
    # Skip comments and empty lines
    [[ "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
    [[ -z "$key" ]] && continue
    
    # Trim whitespace
    key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
    value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)
    
    if [ -n "$value" ]; then
      # Mask the value (show only first 4-6 characters for verification, mask the rest)
      len=${#value}
      if [ $len -le 8 ]; then
        masked="****"
      else
        masked="${value:0:6}...[masked]...${value: -4}"
      fi
      
      case "$key" in
        DATABASE_URL) db_url_status="CONFIGURED ($masked)" ;;
        AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID) aws_key_status="CONFIGURED ($masked)" ;;
        AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY) aws_secret_status="CONFIGURED ($masked)" ;;
        ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) anthropic_status="CONFIGURED ($masked)" ;;
        STRIPE_SECRET_KEY) stripe_status="CONFIGURED ($masked)" ;;
        LOGFIRE_TOKEN) logfire_status="CONFIGURED ($masked)" ;;
      esac
    fi
  done < "$ENV_FILE"
else
  echo -e "${YELLOW}Warning: $ENV_FILE not found.${NC}"
fi

# Construct JSON payload securely
JSON_PAYLOAD=$(cat <<EOF
{
  "timestamp": "$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")",
  "services": {
    "app_3000": "$status_3000_str",
    "proxy_8080": "$status_8080_str"

    "DATABASE_URL": "$db_url_status",
    "AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID": "$aws_key_status",
    "AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY": "$aws_secret_status",
    "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY": "$anthropic_status",
    "STRIPE_SECRET_KEY": "$stripe_status",
    "LOGFIRE_TOKEN": "$logfire_status"
  }
}
EOF
)

echo "Sending health report to monitoring dashboard..."
RESPONSE=$(curl -s -w "\nHTTP_STATUS:%{http_code}" -X POST \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "$JSON_PAYLOAD" \
  http://localhost:3003/api/health-report)

if [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "200" ] || [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "201" ]; then
  echo -e "${GREEN}Health report successfully sent to dashboard (HTTP $HTTP_CODE).${NC}"
else
  echo -e "${RED}Failed to send health report (HTTP $HTTP_CODE).${NC}"
  echo "Response: $BODY"
fi

echo "========================================="
if [ $status_3000 -eq 0 ] && [ $status_8080 -eq 0 ]; then
  echo -e "${GREEN}All services are running successfully.${NC}"
  exit 0
else
  echo -e "${RED}One or more services are down!${NC}"
  exit 1
fi

PORT_8080_STATUS="DOWN"

echo "Timestamp: $(date)"

    echo "RUNNING"

    echo "DOWN"
    FAILED=1

if (echo > /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/8080) >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    PORT_8080_STATUS="RUNNING"
    echo "RUNNING"
else
    echo "DOWN"
    FAILED=1
fi

ENV_FILE_PRESENT=false
ENV_FILE_VALID=false

    # Perform a local check to ensure required keys are defined without exposing their values

    fi

        echo "Failed to send report to monitoring dashboard (curl exit code: $CURL_EXIT)"

    echo "curl is not available; skipping report transmission."

    exit 1
fi

    local port=$1
